definitions.ttfbMs: navigation responseStart: response headers received. Astro streams the body afterwards.
definitions.responseEndMs: navigation responseEnd: last document byte received.
definitions.lcpMs: last largest-contentful-paint candidate before the run settled.
definitions.hydratedMs: every astro-island[client=load] has dropped its ssr attribute, so Astro has handed each island to React.
definitions.interactiveMs: every client:load island's React root has committed with hydration finished, read from a React DevTools global hook the harness installs. interactiveSource says when it fell back to React props on the island's first element.
definitions.settledMs: latest of last DOM mutation, last resource response end, interactive and load, before a 300ms quiet window with no request in flight.
definitions.cls: largest session window (1s gap, 5s cap) of layout shifts without recent input.
definitions.layoutShiftTotal: sum of every layout shift, including input-adjacent ones.
definitions.blockingMs: sum of longtask time beyond 50ms each.
definitions.jsTransferBytes: transferSize of .js and .mjs resources (entry scripts, modulepreloads and dynamic imports).
definitions.requests: requests Playwright observed from the navigation or input until settled, including the document.
definitions.serverTiming: Server-Timing from the document navigation entry and same-origin /api responses. Worker clocks advance across I/O, so pure CPU work can read as 0.
definitions.cdp: Chrome DevTools Protocol Performance.getMetrics, after minus before: TaskDuration, ScriptDuration, LayoutDuration and RecalcStyleDuration in ms, JSHeapUsedSize in bytes after. counterReset means a new document restarted the counters, so the values cover that document only.
definitions.cachedResources: resources served from the HTTP cache (transferSize 0). revalidatedResources answered a conditional request with a smaller transfer than the body.
definitions.documentRequest: the switch issued a main-frame document request.
definitions.firstChangeMs: input click to the first frame showing a change in the workspace region. In place: first mutation inside #astryx-app-shell-main, then requestAnimationFrame plus a MessageChannel task. New document: the later of its first-contentful-paint and that same marker.
definitions.eventMs: largest Event Timing entry (durationThreshold 16) with an interactionId from the input. Null when every entry was under 16ms or the old document unloaded before reporting.
definitions.loading: time a loading element (.astryx-skeleton, .admin-loading, [aria-busy=true]) was present after the input. maxCount counts loading elements at once, maxAnnouncements the distinct role=status ancestors announcing them, and stillVisible means one was present at settle.
